subject: RustSpark sprint: mentor stipend and compute credits request
messages:
From: Julia Ramos <julia@rustspark.org>
To: chloe.martin@redwood.com
Cc: sprint-org@rustspark.org
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Community sprint compute + mentor stipend

Hi Chloe,

We're organizing a 3-day community sprint (RustSpark Collective) on Sept 18-20 focused on building small LLM-powered Rust tooling and demo apps. We typically host ~12 small teams that will each need short-lived inference capacity to prototype — estimated ~200 GPU minutes per team (roughly 2,400 GPU-min total).

We wanted to ask if Redwood can support us with a small promotional package for the event: a hosted trial extension or promotional compute burst to cover the GPU minutes above, plus a mentor stipend for three mentors (~$500 per mentor). The stipend helps cover travel/incidentals and is standard in our sponsor packages.

Attached is the sprint schedule and our standard sponsorship terms for quick review. If possible we need confirmation by Aug 15 in order to include Redwood in the sponsor materials and website. Happy to hop on a 20-min call this week to align.

Thanks so much — excited about the possibility of working together.

—
Julia Ramos
Community Lead, RustSpark Collective
julia@rustspark.org
Attachments: RustSpark_Sprint_Schedule.pdf (PDF), Sponsorship_Terms.docx (DOCX)

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Julia Ramos <julia@rustspark.org>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Community sprint compute + mentor stipend

Hi Julia — thanks for the note and the attachments, really appreciate the timeline. I read through the schedule and sponsorship terms. A couple quick clarifying questions so I can route this for approval: 

- Do the teams need concurrent GPUs (i.e., many teams running at once) or are sessions staggered across the three days? If concurrent, what’s peak concurrent containers you expect?
- Preferred region for the hosted burst (us-west/us-east/eu)?
- Will teams need persistent model checkpoints / KV cache or is this full ephemeral runs per demo?

High level on process: if the ask is ~2.4k GPU-min and a modest mentor stipend, we typically approve a hosted promo package for community events. I’ve looped in Marcus and Vivek to confirm the size of the compute burst and the stipend budget. If approved we’ll send a short sponsorship letter and a DocuSign for the Sponsorship_Terms.docx so legal can sign.

Can you also share the HubSpot record or org billing name so we can create the temporary trial accounts?

If you’re free I can do a quick sync Fri 8/14 at 10am PT — or tell me a slot that works.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Community Programs | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com

On Wed, Aug 12, 2026 at 9:12 AM Julia Ramos <julia@rustspark.org> wrote:

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Julia Ramos <julia@rustspark.org>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Community sprint compute + mentor stipend

Thanks for the ping Chloe — reviewed the schedule and terms. Approve the pilot sponsorship with the following conditions: 

- Offer: one-time hosted promo burst of up to 3,000 GPU-minutes (to cover overhead and a bit of buffer), region: us-west by default.
- Mentor stipend: approved $1,500 total (three mentors @ $500 each).
- Trial accounts: temporary sandbox team accounts valid for 90 days; we'll restrict to hosted inference (no private/Dedicated tokens).
- Legal: request RustSpark sign the Sponsorship_Terms.docx (send via DocuSign).
- Admin: Chloe to provision trial accounts and provide HubSpot org id (HUBSPOT-REC-78392) so we can attach the promo.

Notes: this sits in the community programs budget. Vivek — flagging for FYQ3 spend bucket and accounting code (will provide code separately). Chloe, once Julia confirms concurrent needs we can finalize the exact GPU allocation and issue the promo activation.

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Community sprint compute + mentor stipend

Hi Chloe / Marcus — thank you! That package works great for us and the timeline is perfect. A few quick items from our side: 

- Concurrent sessions: the schedule has two main demo blocks that will overlap — peak concurrent teams likely 6 (out of 12).
- HubSpot org: RustSpark Collective (HUBSPOT-REC-78392).
- We will sign the Sponsorship_Terms.docx; please send DocuSign and billing contact for the mentor stipend (we can pay or Redwood can invoice, whichever you prefer).

Kickoff: can we do the quick sync Mon 8/17 at 11am PT? Also if it helps I can share sample prompts and the small model bundles we plan to use.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — excited to have Redwood listed as a sponsor.

Best,
Julia Ramos
Community Lead, RustSpark Collective
julia@rustspark.org
